QuestInfo.2:
What was someone like Parbell doing in a place veteran Explorers feared to venture? And what was he doing with a precious gem? 
His answers shocked you. He said he was from  #e#bDawnveil#k#n, but you'd never heard of such a place. Was he from beyond the barrier? You wondered if he could help you.
When you mentioned wanting to breach the barrier, he promised to send you across it.
#rYou got the hunch he wasn't just an ordinary old man...#k

0.0: I tell ya what. Y'uns wanna know more about Dawnveil?
0.1: I don't see no harm in telling you what I know.
0.2: Dawnveil's a big ol' place, made up of a buncha different nations. You get what I'm puttin' out there?\r\n

yes.0: Ever since that ol' barrier popped up in Tynerum, we ain't seen much of the other nations. Like we just plum got cut off!
yes.1: But don't go askin' me when this all started! I ain't from around here?
